messages:
Ava: Noticing a bunch of invoices failing reconcile due to tax code mismatches between Stripe line items and NetSuite mapping after yesterday's tax table update. NetSuite rejects with TAXCODE_MISMATCH. Anyone seen this?

billing-bot: nightly-reconcile failed: 02:30 UTC - netsuite_api 409 "TAXCODE_MISMATCH" (reconcile id: nr-2026-03-25-02)

Diego: Yep. Looks like the exporter started sending tax_code=TX-EXM for some EU customers where Stripe had tx_exempt=false. Our tax mapping table changed keys from lowercase to uppercase (tx_exempt -> TX_EXEMPT) and the join returned null for older invoices, defaulting to TX-EXM.

Ava: Example row we sent: customer=cus_Mn4, line_tax: {"taxable": true, "rate_id": "tx_exm"} -> NetSuite receives tax_code=TX-EXM which doesn't match the account's tax nexus.

Priya: Quick finance note: NetSuite flagged ~12 invoices overnight; these are on hold for collections. Need to know if we should manual-adjust tax or re-run sync after fix.

Diego: Root cause: a recent refactor in tax-mapping service normalized keys with strings.ToUpper but some legacy entries in control table remained lowercase. Mapping fallback used a first-match default of EXEMPT.

Ava: Can we hotfix the mapper to do case-insensitive lookup and add a fallback that preserves Stripe's original taxability flag instead of forcing EXEMPT?

Diego: Pushed a patch to make lookups case-insensitive and to prefer explicit Stripe flags. Deployed to canary. Also added unit tests for mixed-case keys.

billing-bot: mapper-canary metrics: 100 requests simulated, 0 mismatches.

Priya: Created TICKET-4325: "Tax code mismatch after tax-mapping refactor -> NetSuite re-sync & holds". Finance will review the 12 invoices and approve re-sync policy. For urgent customer cases, we'll prepare manual tax adjustments.

Ava: For remediations: 1) re-run reconcile for quarantined invoices after canary verification, 2) generate a diff report of tax_code before/after for auditors, 3) add a schema validation step in exporter to ensure tax_code belongs to allowed set for that account.

Diego: Will run a dry-run re-sync once canary passes and attach diff to the ticket. Suggest adding an alert: if more than 5 TAXCODE_MISMATCH errors in a run, auto-pause exports and notify finance.

accounting-bot: quarantine-queue: 12 invoices moved to taxcode-quarantine-2026-03-25.

Priya: Finance will hold dunning and wait for the re-sync. I'll prioritize the top-3 customers for manual fixes today if CS escalates.

Diego: Postmortem planned later today. Action items: add case-insensitive lookup, add audit diff in backfill, add exporter schema guard.

Ava: Thanks team. Please link the diff and canary metrics in TICKET-4325 and loop in Product if this affects billing experiments. :white_check_mark:
